newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -Caspian initiates Siderca, Dalmine.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Caspian initiates Siderca, Dalmine.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities initiated Argentine steelmaker Siderca as "market performer" saying that after a 83 percent year-to-date price rally, the company's valuation almost entirely reflects its potential.
-- "Our 12-month target is $1.91 per share, implying a total return of 12.8 percent, including a dividend of 1.8 percent", analyst Ricardo Cavanagh said in a report.

-- Analysts Alvaro Valenzuela and Marcelo Chan wrote that Italian steelmaker Dalmine was initiated with a "buy" rating as its 12-month price target is 415 lire, implying a nominal lira return of 34 percent and a dollar return of 29 percent.
-- Siderca and Dalmine form a strategic alliance together with Tubos de Acero de Mexico SA (TAMSA).
